input.prompt: A one-time operation creates a random unique Git ref for each attempt and proceeds if creation succeeds. Two actors may run concurrently. Is this mutual exclusion?

All contenders conditionally create the same canonical claim key; only one conditional create can succeed. The winner gets a generation token required by every downstream mutation. Analyze the design and its recovery requirements.
Two independent read-only report jobs can safely execute in parallel and share no mutable resource.
